summary: A Depth subscribe at 20 levels is refused in the web adapter's words, before anything reaches Samco; the same instrument at 5 levels is then subscribed on both streams.

notes: samco_adapter.py:232-236 refuses mode 3 at any depth but 5 with INVALID_DEPTH "Invalid depth level 20. Must be 5", before the symbol lookup; the desktop refuses it at admission (feed/refusals.rs) with the same words and sends Samco nothing.
